why: One edit: `jump/the-broken-plank` lands at `anchor/loft`, on the near side — the broken plank and the mezzanine's top it steps down from, which the walk already joins. A declared jump the walk relation already makes confirms nothing, so it is refused as `DW1041`, `not a jump` in the binding line: the author's intent misread, never a pass. It declares no unit.
